analysis.reasonEn: Recent 5-day -10.85% drop pushed RSI down to 38.0, entering oversold territory. MACD histogram worsened from 3.4073 to -6.2960, continuing weakness. A Higher Low pattern is forming with the 5-day low ($517.47) above the 20-day low ($514.80). Current price $521.81 is near the lower Bollinger Band ($521.95). Aligns with overall market QQQ -2.1% drop.
